reviews.text:
I mainly use their grooming services.

While it's not the cheapest, they have a groomer who does a great job of making my dog ​​look adorable, and they also take lovely, seasonal photos for free every time, which is a big plus.

It's also convenient that we can exchange the photos and other information via LINE.

This was my first time using a pet hotel. Since we also use their clinic, I felt confident leaving my pet there.

I was even more relieved to see through their stories that my pet was enjoying themselves as usual during their stay.

Thank you so much for everything.
Thank you so much for always taking care of our travels. It's so reassuring to see how much fun we're having on Instagram! The staff are also very polite and kind. Thank you always!

We used your pet hotel and shampoo service again this time.
I'm so grateful that my pet was able to relax at the hotel.
The shampoo service included a herbal pack, leaving my pet sparkling clean.
We look forward to using your services again. 🙇 …

Since the salon is attached to a clinic, I felt at ease visiting for the first time. During the consultation, they carefully showed me various photos to help me decide on the desired length and other details. I'm very happy with the neat yet cute, rounded cut. They also sent me photos afterward, which my family and I enjoyed looking at. Since he's still a puppy, I'm looking forward to seeing what other styles he can have in the future. The staff were all very kind, and I would definitely like to use their services again. Thank you very much.

We took our 4-month-old Maltipoo for its first grooming session!

I was a little worried because my puppy is always on the move, but the staff were incredibly kind and attentive, which put me at ease. 🐶
The person who groomed him seemed to genuinely love dogs, and I would definitely like to use their services again next time. 🩵

I used their pet hotel service and was very grateful for their courteous service. They also uploaded videos of my pet's stay on Instagram, which gave me peace of mind. I would definitely use their service again.

I honestly don't understand why this hospital has such high ratings.
I had visited the hospital several times in the past when I had persistent bloody stools, but they made me undergo various tests and never found the cause. However, when I went to another hospital, they quickly determined that the cause was a parasite and the problem was solved.
After being made to pay expensive tests, I became distrustful and changed hospitals, wondering why they couldn't tell me something so basic.
The doctor was also very overbearing and unpleasant.

Potato has been in the care of this veterinary clinic since he was a puppy. I also have him groomed and taken to the pet hotel here, and the doctors and groomers are all so kind and considerate that I feel very safe leaving him there.

We use their hospital and hotel for their care.
My dog ​​can be a bit temperamental, which is typical of Shiba Inu dogs, so I've consulted them not only when he's unwell, but also when he starts chewing his hair and becomes traumatized by thunder and develops anxiety and separation disorder.
The doctors and staff are very good at handling him, and he seems to get used to them quickly.
The videos and photos they send us are all cute and funny, and you can tell they were taken from the perspective of someone who loves animals, so I can leave him at the hotel with peace of mind.

This is a veterinary hospital I want to keep going to☆
